Anna —

Thanks for the CSV and spec. Confirming Redwood can take the masters and do the caption pass. A few quick clarifications before we schedule the ingest: 

- File naming: prefer session_slug included in filename (helps with automated metadata ingestion). If BlueStage will also provide a JSON manifest we can map to our catalog.
- Caption spec: your style guide looks good. We'll run automatic alignment and then a human QA pass for speaker labels. Expect a TAT of ~24 hours per file after ingest.
- Retention: default hosted retention is 90 days. 180 days is possible but requires a short addendum (cost delta + S3 storage tiering). Marissa / Tessa: can you pull the Hosted Events pricing appendix and estimate incremental monthly storage for the expected total (CSV lists ~18 sessions, avg 22 min)?

Action items for BlueStage: upload masters to S3, optionally include JSON manifest with timecodes for embedded slides.

I'll schedule a 30-min AV ingest slot for Thursday morning (9/17) to smoke-test one file and caption pipeline. Please confirm who from BlueStage will accept the file transfer test (Anna?).

Thanks —
Marcus Lin

Hi all —

Quick wrap: we completed the ingest test this morning and then batch-ingested the remaining 17 masters from BlueStage S3. Notes below:

- Ingest: files uploaded to s3://bluestage-events/2026-09-21/pre-records/ and copied to Redwood staging. Manifest mapping applied (session_slug present).
- Caption pass: auto-align + human QA completed for all sessions. Caption files are in sidecar VTT format; we used BlueStage spec (speaker labels ON).
- One issue: wong_session_final.mp4 had variable frame rate; we transcode to constant-frame h.264 baseline for consistent playback. Emily — there was no slide drift after transcode; timings preserved.
- Retention: Jake (Acme) asked for 180 days. Pricing delta estimated at ~$72/month additional storage; Marissa will follow up with exact invoice item. For now we've applied a 180-day retention tag on the staging copies and set a scheduled lifecycle rule to move to infrequent tier after 30 days.

Links: ingest folder (https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-events/2026-09-21/pre-records/), caption bundle (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C)

Next steps: Marissa to confirm invoice addendum by Monday; Anna to confirm final S3 ACL if BlueStage wants the masters purged early.

Thanks — great teamwork.

—Tessa
